name: Femboys of Tomorrow
source: You and your sister have spent your lives searching for a place to call home. When a prestigious university offers you both stability and a future, you accept despite its strict expectations. Drawn into a world shaped by control and transformation, you must adapt, endure, and decide what it truly means to surrender or to fight for your identity. Along the way, you form a close bond with another student who shares your struggle, while facing the growing influence of someone determined to pull you deeper under his control.
translation: 你和你的妹妹一生都在寻找一个可以称之为家的地方。当一所著名大学为你提供稳定和未来时，你会接受，尽管它有严格的期望。被吸引到一个由控制和变革塑造的世界中，你必须适应、忍受并决定投降或为自己的身份而战的真正含义。一路上，你与另一名与你有同样挣扎的学生建立了密切的联系，同时面对一个决心将你更深地控制在他手中的人日益增长的影响力。
